method_cards.scope: Give each materially distinct example its own finding and literal evidence: an anchor for marriage cannot carry childhood, populism or Nazism. Retain the full conditional antecedent and its consequent in separate spans if needed. Preserve bracketed letters such as [i]f exactly; do not silently normalize them in a quotation.
method_cards.possibility_tests: Distinguish an illustrative possibility, a necessary condition and a blocked outcome. Quote the blockage contrast as well as the positive example; preserve whose modal judgment is being inventoried.

method_cards.senses: Inventory each sense separately before comparing them. A finding about two uses needs evidence for both; quote the noun or speaker antecedent separately when the local phrase only says she, this or it.
method_cards.paired_usage: For each contrast, retain literal spans for both poles, including individual/universal and immediate/mediated where relevant. Do not attach a second sense to the evidence for the first.
method_cards.boundaries: Quote the complete dependence or independence predicate, including what the process is independent of and whose claim it is. A nearby phrase cannot support a missing object.

method_cards.synthesis: Preserve granular findings for the distinct resources and the enacted combination through deduplication. A generic combining-strengths announcement is not a duplicate of a finding that identifies a particular mechanism. If merging, carry all supporting spans and update every dependent cell to the surviving evidence.
method_cards.moves: Anchor what is added, transformed or combined with its complete object and result, not just an announcement of a new framework. Separate each construction move that needs different evidence.

method_cards.time: Retain complete temporal sequences and financial or historical conditions: a conditional future is not an accomplished transition. Use separate literal spans for antecedent, sequence and consequence where one short quote cannot carry them.
method_cards.perspective: Name each attributed voice from an explicit attribution span; preserve whether the text reports, endorses or contests the voice. Keep the quoted position and its attribution together.

method_cards.correspondence: Across page headers or intervening material, give two literal spans, never a silently joined quotation. Preserve the full asserted correspondence and its speaker.
method_cards.criterion: Distinguish salient features, necessary conditions and sufficient criteria. Do not promote a feature list to a sufficient classification without an explicit warrant. Quote the actual criterion and any passage limiting its force.
method_cards.alternatives: Read the strongest supplied alternative inference before ranking it. Anchor the complete alternative, including its actor, resources and power where asserted; a stock example alone cannot establish the conclusion.

method_cards.alternatives_and_scope: Inspect the strongest actual dependencies and counterexamples, including an inference that survives without granting the opponent premise and a rhetorical counterexample where supplied. Reconstruct the alternative route with complete attributed support before deciding which assumption matters.
method_cards.supposition_and_function: Keep granting an opponent premise for argument separate from endorsing it. Reconcile attribution across the finding, explanatory prose and table; use separate spans for the speaker and the supposed outcome.

method_cards.positions_and_attribution: Check every position against its named speaker and maintain the same attribution in findings, prose and tables. Do not exchange reflective and critical objections. A selective use of a thinker does not endorse every verdict attributed to that thinker.
method_cards.remainder_and_consequence: Carry the complete boundary distinction into the finding, including interest-bearing versus fictitious capital where the text distinguishes them. Preserve necessity of vulnerability separately from contingency of outcome. If the critic changes a remainder classification, rewrite its final table cell.

method_cards.relations: A comparison of two frameworks inside ONE article is a document finding in relations. Reserve framework_comparison for relations across two distinct supplied documents; two theorists, lenses or examples are not two document keys. Quote each mechanism and attributed component separately.
method_cards.limits: Give each application or example its own anchored finding; a childhood example cannot also evidence a marriage claim. Preserve source-literal bracketed letters and complete actor or country attribution.
method_cards.framework_comparison: Use this dimension only for at least two distinct supplied works. With one article, put its internal framework comparison in the document dimension relations, with that one document identity and no corpus lineage.

method_cards.local_meanings: Build an aligned concept-by-work inventory: inspect EACH shared concept in EACH work, including secondary uses. Do not give each work only its headline concept. Preserve local concessions and general claims at their respective scopes.
method_cards.argumentative_roles: Quote the causal consequence as well as the initiating struggle or action; a wage/hour conflict alone cannot evidence a consumer-market or expectation consequence.
method_cards.concept_trajectories: Before assigning change, inspect the earlier positive claim and its qualifications. Align the same concept, object and role across works. Keep a local neutrality concession distinct from a general non-neutrality claim; put paired evidence and scope directly in the corresponding cells.

method_cards.changed_purpose: Inspect the earlier work for the full positive claim before describing a later change. A sign-to-substance or salvation-to-money move already stated earlier is continuity or renewed emphasis. Quote the transfer predicate completely, not an also prefix.
method_cards.acknowledgment: Give every named attribution its own supporting span. Evidence for one named theorist does not establish another theorist in the same cell; split the attributions.
method_cards.borrowing_and_use: Align each borrowed concept in both works and carry the earlier affirmative formulation alongside the later one. Separate changed presentation, changed purpose and already-present argument. Do not infer transmission from resemblance; preserve earlier qualifications.

method_cards.scope_and_force: Inventory the earlier conditional and anti-utopian qualifications before interpreting later caution as change. Retain these qualifications in the earlier work cell beside the later wording.
method_cards.support: Inspect whether epistemic, social-complexity and property-rights support already appears earlier. Support each component separately; a later prominence or new wording is not a new argument.
method_cards.revision_record: Compare aligned concept-by-work cells and inspect the earlier positive argument as well as its limitations. Distinguish new presentation or emphasis from new reasoning; carry earlier qualifications and avoid inventing a self-revision relation.
